issues.title: Introduce precision and recall in beginner-friendly terms
issues.body:
## Goal

Define **precision** and **recall** separately, avoiding unexplained mathematical jargon.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Explain definitions clearly enough for a first-time ML learner.

## Helpful starting point

Think of spam filters: precision asks whether flagged messages are actually spam; recall asks how much spam was found.
